mbstowcs/wcstombs.contract: Private call-local conversion state; C ASCII or strict UTF-8 selected by existing LC_CTYPE. NULL destination counts entire input, n ignored. Bounds count wide elements/bytes respectively, NUL excluded from count. No partial UTF-8 character output. Invalid/overlong/surrogate/truncated sequences fail EILSEQ. Size overflow fails EOVERFLOW. No allocation, no cross-call state.
mbstowcs/wcstombs.thread_safety: Independent calls supported; locale changes require external serialization, as for existing restartable interfaces.
native_negative_tests: guard page at source terminator and exact bound

localeconv/lconv.contract: Process-lifetime read-only metadata: decimal dot, empty grouping/thousands/monetary strings, CHAR_MAX for unspecified monetary numeric fields. All installed locale names retain the C numeric/monetary baseline; en_US.UTF-8 is not a full US locale. Native LP64 pointer/char layout is declared in locale.h.
localeconv/lconv.thread_safety: Immutable storage; callers must not mutate returned data.

setvbuf/setbuf.contract: _IONBF succeeds on a live stream, which is already unbuffered. _IOFBF/_IOLBF fail ENOSYS; unknown modes fail EINVAL. Caller storage never retained or dereferenced. NULL stream fails EINVAL. setbuf delegates and reports failure only through errno. Existing unbuffered I/O remains authoritative.
setvbuf/setbuf.buffered_IO: BLOCKED within this implementation; requires real buffer ownership/read-write/seek/flush design, not a successful no-op.

clock_getres.contract: CLOCK_REALTIME reports 1 second; CLOCK_MONOTONIC reports 10 ms, matching native RTC/syscall and 100 Hz timekeeper. NULL output allowed. Invalid clock leaves storage untouched and fails EINVAL; success preserves errno.

_exit.contract: Callback-free process-group termination via sl_std_exit/syscall 157, identical immediate termination primitive used by inherited _Exit. Never pthread_exit.
_exit.native_test: Worker invokes _exit(38); guest observes group status 38 and no owner-survival/atexit output.

strncpy.contract: Copies at most n bytes and pads remainder after first NUL, returns destination, byte-alignment independent. Overlapping source/destination is undefined by C; no memmove promise.
tests: Existing string-guard case at unmapped next page
contracts-test unaligned destination, exact nonterminated bound, zero bound, zero padding/canaries

_Exit.test: Existing immediate-exit worker _Exit(37) fixture, lifecycle exit matrix; normal exit/main return and pthread_exit retain their separate paths.

mutable_environment.reason: Existing Rust getters return process-lifetime immutable references into envp; setenv/unsetenv need coherent ownership/lifetime and synchronization design, not mutation/free of borrowed storage.

calendar_time.reason: Native wall clock exists and is not fabricated, but tm/timeval/calendar conversions, strftime, timezone and CPU accounting interfaces remain missing. This is remaining libc implementation work, not a claim that all require kernel changes.

langinfo_calendar.reason: Only CODESET exists. CPython _locale requires DAY/ABDAY/MON/ABMON and format/AM/PM constants/data. No placeholders added.

abort.reason: SIGABRT delivery/disposition is unsupported; do not pretend _Exit is a full abort contract.
